papers.title: Meta-Active Learning for Node Response Prediction in Graphs
papers.abstract: Meta-learning is an important approach to improve machine learning performance with a limited number of observations for target tasks. However, when observations are unbalancedly obtained, it is difficult to improve the performance even with meta-learning methods. In this paper, we propose an active learning method for meta-learning on node response prediction tasks in attributed graphs, where nodes to observe are selected to improve performance with as few observed nodes as possible. With the proposed method, we use models based on graph convolutional neural networks for both predicting node responses and selecting nodes, by which we can predict responses and select nodes even for graphs with unseen response variables. The response prediction model is trained by minimizing the expected test error. The node selection model is trained by maximizing the expected error reduction with reinforcement learning. We demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed method with 11 types of road congestion prediction tasks.

llm.relevance_to_user: 本文提出的元主动学习方法可泛化至图结构数据，但未涉及FEA代理建模、不确定性量化或生物力学约束处理，与用户方向关联弱。
llm.why_not_core: The paper does not address FEA surrogate modeling, uncertainty quantification, constraint handling, or any biomechanical/implant design context.

summary_zh.motivation: 在属性图中用少量观测节点提高节点响应预测性能
summary_zh.method: 基于图卷积网络的元主动学习，用强化学习选择观测节点
summary_zh.result: 在11种道路交通预测任务上验证了有效性
summary_zh.validation: 在道路交通数据集上进行数值实验

summary_en.motivation: To improve node response prediction in attributed graphs with limited labeled nodes using meta-learning and active learning.
summary_en.method: A meta-active learning framework combining graph convolutional networks for response prediction and reinforcement learning for node selection.
summary_en.result: The method achieves effective performance on 11 road congestion prediction tasks.
summary_en.validation: Evaluated on multiple road traffic datasets with varying graph structures and response variables.

papers.title: Multi-Objective Bayesian Optimisation and Joint Inversion for Active Sensor Fusion
papers.abstract: A critical decision process in data acquisition for mineral and energy resource exploration is how to efficiently combine a variety of sensor types and to minimize total cost. We propose a probabilistic framework for multi-objective optimisation and inverse problems given an expensive cost function for allocating new measurements. This new method is devised to jointly solve multi-linear forward models of 2D-sensor data and 3D-geophysical properties using sparse Gaussian Process kernels while taking into account the cross-variances of different parameters. Multiple optimisation strategies are tested and evaluated on a set of synthetic and real geophysical data. We demonstrate the advantages on a specific example of a joint inverse problem, recommending where to place new drill-core measurements given 2D gravity and magnetic sensor data, the same approach can be applied to a variety of remote sensing problems with linear forward models - ranging from constraints limiting surface access for data acquisition to adaptive multi-sensor positioning.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该方法中的多目标贝叶斯优化和稀疏高斯过程可以迁移到生物力学中的代理模型优化问题。
llm.why_not_core: This paper does not involve finite element analysis, implant mechanics, or any biomedical validation context.

summary_zh.motivation: 资源勘探中如何高效结合多种传感器并最小化数据采集成本。
summary_zh.method: 提出基于稀疏高斯过程的多目标贝叶斯优化框架，联合求解前向模型与反问题。
summary_zh.result: 在合成与真实地球物理数据上验证了方法，有效指导了钻探测量位置选择。
summary_zh.validation: 使用二维重力和磁传感器数据合成及实测案例验证。

summary_en.motivation: Efficiently combining multiple sensor types to minimize data acquisition cost in resource exploration.
summary_en.method: A probabilistic multi-objective Bayesian optimization framework using sparse Gaussian processes to jointly solve linear forward models and inverse problems.
summary_en.result: The method effectively recommends placement of new drill-core measurements using 2D gravity and magnetic data, demonstrated on synthetic and real geophysical datasets.
summary_en.validation: Validated on both synthetic and real geophysical data for a joint inversion problem with multi-linear forward models.

papers.title: Effect of low-level laser therapy on osseointegration of titanium dental implants in ovariectomized rabbits: biomechanics and micro-CT analysis.
papers.abstract: PURPOSE: The primary aim of this study is to assess, in an animal model, whether biostimulation of osteoporotic bone with low-level laser therapy improves the osseointegration of dental implants. MATERIAL AND METHODS: Twenty-two female rabbits were randomly divided into two groups: sham-ovariectomy and bilateral-ovariectomy. Laser therapy was applied to the implants placed in the right tibial bones and was not applied to implants placed in the left tibial bones. The periotest device was used for the stability test. Periotest values were recorded after the implantation (T0) and when the animals were euthanized (T1). The removal torque test and micro-computed tomography examination were evaluated. RESULTS: As a result of removal torque, the mean of ovariectomy-laser group (56.1 ± 5.1 Ncm) was higher than sham-ovariectomy group (55.4 ± 18.5 Ncm) (p = 0.9). In periotest analysis, a significant difference was found between the values of T1 and T0 in all groups, except sham-ovariectomy group (p < 0.05); and the highest difference was found in the ovariectomy-laser group. Micro-CT examination demonstrated that ovariectomy-laser group showed an increase of implant-bone contact when compared with ovariectomy (p < 0.05). CONCLUSIONS: The values obtained from biomechanical tests and micro-CT in the ovariectomy-laser group were significantly higher than the ovariectomy group and achieved the values in the healthy bone.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究了激光治疗对骨质疏松骨中牙种植体骨整合的影响，但未涉及多孔结构、应力遮挡或增材制造，与用户方向关联性弱。
llm.why_not_core: No LPBF fabrication, no porous structure design, no stress shielding analysis, no fatigue testing, and no surface roughness characterization.

summary_zh.motivation: 评估激光治疗对骨质疏松骨中牙种植体骨整合的改善作用
summary_zh.method: 将22只雌兔分为假手术组和去卵巢组，对植入物进行激光治疗，通过稳定性测试、扭矩测试和显微CT评估
summary_zh.result: 激光治疗组在扭矩测试和骨接触方面显著高于未治疗组，接近健康骨水平
summary_zh.validation: 通过动物实验、力学测试和显微CT成像验证

summary_en.motivation: To assess whether low-level laser therapy can improve dental implant osseointegration in osteoporotic bone in an animal model.
summary_en.method: Twenty-two female rabbits were divided into sham-ovariectomy and bilateral-ovariectomy groups; laser therapy was applied to implants in the right tibia, with left tibia as control, and evaluated via periotest stability, removal torque, and micro-CT.
summary_en.result: The ovariectomy-laser group showed significantly higher removal torque and implant-bone contact compared to the non-laser ovariectomy group, reaching values comparable to healthy bone.
summary_en.validation: Validation was performed using in vivo animal experiments, biomechanical testing (periotest and removal torque), and micro-CT imaging.

papers.title: Toward Antibacterial Coatings for Personalized Implants.
papers.abstract: The complex reconstructive surgeries for which patient-specific orthopedic, maxillofacial, or dental implants are used often necessitate wounds that are open for a considerable amount of time. Unsurprisingly, this allows bacteria to establish implant-associated infection, despite the scrupulous sterilization efforts made during surgery. Here, we developed a prophylactic bactericidal coating via electrophoretic deposition technology for two 3D-printed porous titanium implant designs. The surface characteristics, antibiotic release behavior, antibacterial properties, and impact on osteoblast cell proliferation of the optimized coatings were investigated. The results unequivocally confirmed the biofunctionality of the implants in vitro. This study reveals a new avenue for future antibacterial patient-specific implants.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文关注3D打印钛植入体的抗菌涂层，而非力学性能或应力遮挡问题。
llm.why_not_core: No mechanical testing (static or fatigue), no LPBF fabrication details, no stress shielding or stiffness matching analysis, no surface roughness characterization for osseointegration.

summary_zh.motivation: 开发适用于个性化植入体的抗菌涂层，预防感染。
summary_zh.method: 通过电泳沉积技术在3D打印多孔钛支架上制备抗菌涂层。
summary_zh.result: 涂层具有良好的抗生素释放能力和抗菌性能，并促进成骨细胞增殖。
summary_zh.validation: 通过体外实验验证涂层功能。

summary_en.motivation: To develop a prophylactic bactericidal coating for patient-specific 3D-printed porous titanium implants to prevent implant-associated infections.
summary_en.method: Electrophoretic deposition was used to apply an antibiotic-releasing coating onto two designs of 3D-printed porous titanium implants.
summary_en.result: The optimized coating exhibited sustained antibiotic release, effective antibacterial activity, and supported osteoblast cell proliferation in vitro.
summary_en.validation: In vitro assays including antibiotic release, antibacterial tests, and cell proliferation studies were conducted.
